We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Customer Support Representative&nbsp;

Job Location: Remote

Description


	We are looking for a dedicated, diligent Customer Support Representative to handle fast-evolving customer enquiries across our brands. You&#39;ll be the first point of contact for our customers, resolving issues quickly and keeping every conversation clear, calm, and professional.
	You will respond to customer enquiries across multiple channels, resolve issues promptly, and keep accurate records of every interaction. Because Virtual Nation operates across several brands, you&#39;ll need to correctly categorise tickets, identify which project or brand an enquiry relates to, and respond accordingly, even when a customer&#39;s request is unclear or mixes multiple products together.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer enquiries via phone, email, live chat, and social media promptly and professionally
	Categorise tickets accurately by brand, project, and issue type
	Untangle and clarify confusing enquiries that span multiple projects or brands
	Resolve customer complaints and issues by identifying root causes and providing effective solutions
	Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate internal team with clear notes
	Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions in the CRM system
	Follow up with customers to confirm issues have been fully resolved
	Provide accurate information about products, services, policies, and procedures
	Stay up to date on all Virtual Nation brands and products to respond confidently
	Identify recurring issues and feed insights back to the relevant team
	Meet or exceed performance targets for response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction


Performance Metrics &amp; KPIs


	Average response time
	Ticket resolution rate
	Ticket categorisation accuracy
	Customer satisfaction scores
	Escalation accuracy (right issue routed to the right team)


What Success Looks Like


	At 90 days: You&#39;re confidently handling enquiries across all brands, categorising tickets accurately, and resolving most issues without needing escalation.
	At 1 year: You&#39;re a trusted first point of contact for customers, known for turning confusing, multi-brand enquiries into clear, fast resolutions. Your feedback has helped improve internal processes.


Skills &amp; Competencies Required
Must-have:


	3+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or a related client-facing role
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills
	Strong ability to categorise and prioritise tickets accurately
	Ability to clarify and resolve confusing or ambiguous enquiries
	Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills
	Ability to multitask and manage multiple conversations at once
	Calm, patient, and professional under pressure
	Familiarity with CRM or helpdesk/ticketing tools


Nice-to-have:


	Experience supporting multiple brands or products at once
	Experience using helpdesk tools (Zoho, Freshdesk, Zendesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar)
	Background in tech, SaaS, or digital product support


Compensation &amp; Benefits


	Opportunity to rise into a management role
	Bonus and results-driven performance bonus
	Remote work culture
	Flexible and friendly environment
	Competitive salary
	Opportunity for training and personal development.

Customer Support Representative Job at Virtual Nation




        
    

        
        Virtual Nation -  We started one brand, then another, and discovered that Virtual Nation worked best behind the scenes, letting each brand stay focused on what mattered without the noise of a shared name. Today our company spans three brands — a global migration platform, a university admissions companion, and a digital growth agency — serving customers across the globe.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Support Representative 

Job Location: Remote

Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a dedicated, diligent Customer Support Representative to handle fast-evolving customer enquiries across our brands. You'll be the first point of contact for our customers, resolving issues quickly and keeping every conversation clear, calm, and professional.
	You will respond to customer enquiries across multiple channels, resolve issues promptly, and keep accurate records of every interaction. Because Virtual Nation operates across several brands, you'll need to correctly categorise tickets, identify which project or brand an enquiry relates to, and respond accordingly, even when a customer's request is unclear or mixes multiple products together.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer enquiries via phone, email, live chat, and social media promptly and professionally
	Categorise tickets accurately by brand, project, and issue type
	Untangle and clarify confusing enquiries that span multiple projects or brands
	Resolve customer complaints and issues by identifying root causes and providing effective solutions
	Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate internal team with clear notes
	Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions in the CRM system
	Follow up with customers to confirm issues have been fully resolved
	Provide accurate information about products, services, policies, and procedures
	Stay up to date on all Virtual Nation brands and products to respond confidently
	Identify recurring issues and feed insights back to the relevant team
	Meet or exceed performance targets for response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction


Performance Metrics & KPIs


	Average response time
	Ticket resolution rate
	Ticket categorisation accuracy
	Customer satisfaction scores
	Escalation accuracy (right issue routed to the right team)


What Success Looks Like


	At 90 days: You're confidently handling enquiries across all brands, categorising tickets accurately, and resolving most issues without needing escalation.
	At 1 year: You're a trusted first point of contact for customers, known for turning confusing, multi-brand enquiries into clear, fast resolutions. Your feedback has helped improve internal processes.


Skills & Competencies Required
Must-have:


	3+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or a related client-facing role
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills
	Strong ability to categorise and prioritise tickets accurately
	Ability to clarify and resolve confusing or ambiguous enquiries
	Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills
	Ability to multitask and manage multiple conversations at once
	Calm, patient, and professional under pressure
	Familiarity with CRM or helpdesk/ticketing tools


Nice-to-have:


	Experience supporting multiple brands or products at once
	Experience using helpdesk tools (Zoho, Freshdesk, Zendesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar)
	Background in tech, SaaS, or digital product support


Compensation & Benefits


	Opportunity to rise into a management role
	Bonus and results-driven performance bonus
	Remote work culture
	Flexible and friendly environment
	Competitive salary
	Opportunity for training and personal development.

At LiDA, we focus on clarity, execution, and performance ensuring that every creative output aligns with business objectives. Job Summary


	We are looking for a Visual Content Producer who can turn real people, brands, business moments and client stories into high quality visual content.
	This is not an editing-only role. You will be expected to think creatively, plan shoots, capture strong photos and videos, edit professionally, and deliver content that serves a clear communication or business purpose.

	Plan and execute photo and video shoots for Lida and client accounts.
	Capture corporate portraits, events, interviews, products, behind-the-scenes moments, business interactions and lifestyle content.

	Edit video content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, websites, presentations and other digital platforms.

	Work closely with the Brand, Growth and Account teams to understand the purpose of every piece of content.

	Support content capture during client meetings, events, activations and other field assignments.
	Maintain high standards for equipment handling, file management and timely delivery.

	A strong portfolio or showreel that demonstrates photography, videography, editing and visual storytelling.
	Proven ability to independently handle a project from planning through shooting and final delivery.
	Strong understanding of camera operation, composition, lighting and basic audio recording.
	Confidence shooting both photo and video in corporate, event, interview, product and lifestyle settings.
	Strong photo editing skills using Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, or similar professional tools.
	Strong video editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar tools.
	Experience creating content for social media, especially vertical video formats, without sacrificing quality.
	Good eye for detail, colour, framing, pacing and brand consistency.
	Ability to work fast when required, while protecting quality.
	Clear communication, professionalism and comfort working directly with clients and team members.
	Willingness to work on location across Abuja when required.


Added Advantage:


	Experience with motion graphics, simple animation or graphic overlays.
	Drone filming experience.
	Experience producing content for professional services, corporate brands, founders or business leaders.


What Success Looks Like:

Visual Content Producer Job at LiDA Digital Agency




        
    

        
        LiDA Digital is a growth-focused branding and marketing agency that works with businesses to turn their brand into a measurable business asset. We specialize in brand strategy, visual identity, digital marketing, content production, and advertising, helping companies move from visibility to real results.
     

            
    



Our clients span industries such as real estate, corporate services, and emerging startups, where we support positioning, customer acquisition, and long-term brand growth. At LiDA, we focus on clarity, execution, and performance ensuring that every creative output aligns with business objectives. We’re a fast-growing, execution-driven team that values creativity, ownership, and high standards, offering opportunities to work on impactful projects and build brands at scale. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Visual Content Producer
Job Location: Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary


	We are looking for a Visual Content Producer who can turn real people, brands, business moments and client stories into high quality visual content.
	This is not an editing-only role. You will be expected to think creatively, plan shoots, capture strong photos and videos, edit professionally, and deliver content that serves a clear communication or business purpose.


What You Will Do


	Plan and execute photo and video shoots for Lida and client accounts.
	Capture corporate portraits, events, interviews, products, behind-the-scenes moments, business interactions and lifestyle content.
	Produce polished talking-head interviews, social media videos, campaign content, event recaps and brand films.
	Edit photographs to a high professional standard using strong retouching, colour correction and composition.
	Edit video content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, websites, presentations and other digital platforms.
	Apply professional colour grading, sound cleanup, captions, pacing and visual storytelling.
	Develop shot lists, simple storyboards and visual treatments before key shoots.
	Work closely with the Brand, Growth and Account teams to understand the purpose of every piece of content.
	Organise, back up and maintain photo, video and project files for easy future use.
	Support content capture during client meetings, events, activations and other field assignments.
	Maintain high standards for equipment handling, file management and timely delivery.


What We Are Looking For


	A strong portfolio or showreel that demonstrates photography, videography, editing and visual storytelling.
	Proven ability to independently handle a project from planning through shooting and final delivery.
	Strong understanding of camera operation, composition, lighting and basic audio recording.
	Confidence shooting both photo and video in corporate, event, interview, product and lifestyle settings.
	Strong photo editing skills using Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, or similar professional tools.
	Strong video editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar tools.
	Experience creating content for social media, especially vertical video formats, without sacrificing quality.
	Good eye for detail, colour, framing, pacing and brand consistency.
	Ability to work fast when required, while protecting quality.
	Clear communication, professionalism and comfort working directly with clients and team members.
	Willingness to work on location across Abuja when required.


Added Advantage:


	Experience with motion graphics, simple animation or graphic overlays.
	Drone filming experience.
	Experience producing content for professional services, corporate brands, founders or business leaders.


What Success Looks Like:


	You will help Lida and its clients tell stronger stories, build more credible visual identities and create content people stop, watch and remember.
	We value people who bring ideas, take ownership of their work and understand that creative quality must support real business outcomes.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV,  link to your portfolio, showreel or Instagram page, three examples of work you personally shot and edited, ashort note explaining the role you played on each project and a short answer to this question: What makes a visual story effective? to: [email protected] using "Application — Visual Content Producer" as the subject of the mail. 

Note: Applications without a portfolio or showreel will not be considered.

Assistant Store Officer Job at Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital




        
    

        
        Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital (GOUNITH), formerly Ntasi Obi Hospital, is a premier university teaching hospital, that stands at the vibrant intersection of research, education, and patient care. This unique synergy allows us to deliver exceptional, compassionate care while constantly innovating and advancing the field of medicine.

We believe in a holistic approach to wellness. We are more than just a hospital; we are a hub of medical excellence where every patient visit contributes to a new generation of healthcare leaders.

Applications are invited from suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Store Officer 
     

            
    



Job Location: Enugu
Job type: Full-time
Department: Procurement / Store Unit

Qualifications


	Candidates should possess an OND in Business Studies.


General Requirements
Applicants must:


	Possess the prescribed academic and professional qualifications relevant to the position applied for.
	Be duly registered with the appropriate professional regulatory body, where applicable
	Possess a valid practicing license where required.
	Demonstrate relevant post-qualification experience and professional competence.
	Exhibit integrity, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment. 
	Must be ICT compliant.


Remuneration
The new salary scale is very attractive.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit a formal application addressed to:
The Registrar,
Godfrey Okoye University Teaching Hospital (GOUNITH),
Thinker's Corner, Enugu State.
And
Applications should also be forwarded to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Application documents should contain the following listed below:


	A detailed and up-to-date Curriculum Vitae (CV) Copies of academic and professional certificates.
	Names and addresses of three (3) referees, one of whom should be the applicant's current or most recent employer.


Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview.

	Welcome and receive customers, visitors, suppliers and other guests professionally.
	Serve as the first point of contact for customers and visitors.

	Assist customers with product selection and basic product information.

Future Moves Recruitment Agency (FMR Agency) - Our client, a Logistics Company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accountant
Job Location: Okija, Anambra
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Accountant to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing financial records, preparing reports, monitoring transactions, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and company policies.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports
	Handle daily accounting operations and reconciliations
	Monitor cash flow, expenses, and budget performance
	Process invoices, payments, and financial transactions
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
	Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies
	• Support audits and tax-related activities
	• Utilize accounting software effectively for financial management and reporting.


Requirements


	B.Sc/HND in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related field
	2 years of proven accounting experience
	Professional certification such as ICAN, ACA, or ACCA is mandatory
	Proficiency in accounting software such as Sage, QuickBooks, or ERP systems
	Strong analytical and numerical skills
	Good knowledge of financial reporting and reconciliation
	Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
